checks.name: TP Delta - Fault Threshold (set every cell to 22 before enabling AutoBlip)

consent.text: The gear and speed readings switch to the ECU's own tyre value (the OEM path): throttle feel per gear, the DSC / torque gear input and the tyre byte on CAN can change, and the NC Flash / Romdrop tyre-size setting stops having any effect.

next_steps: Flash this file, then drive with AutoBlip off (Enable = 0).
Log the confirmed gear in every gear (5th at several speeds).
Set every cell of TP Delta - Fault Threshold to 22.
Then set AutoBlip - Enable = 1 and flash again.
